name: ai-tool-tracker
description: A side panel for Claude Code that shows which plugins, skills and MCP tools you use while you work, what each is for, and suggests tools for what you want to build. 작업 중 쓰인 플러그인·스킬을 실시간으로 보여주고, 필요한 도구를 찾아 추천해 주는 패널.

language.title: Language / 언어
language.description: Language for tool descriptions in the panel. Non-English/Korean choices are translated once by the session's model and cached.

minStars.title: Minimum stars to recommend / 추천에 필요한 최소 별 개수
minStars.description: Suggestions from unreviewed sources with fewer GitHub stars than this are not recommended. 0 turns the check off. / 검토되지 않은 저장소가 이 개수보다 별이 적으면 추천하지 않습니다. 0이면 거르지 않습니다.
